name: Beas (Spain)
description: Yellow field with two bands of white and blue stripes rising diagonally from the lower corners to meet at the middle of the upper edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Beas (a castle, a chequy field and a lion).
history: The arms of Beas were approved by the Ministry of the Interior in 1968 and the flag by the municipal council on 9 June 1998; the flag has a yellow ground with two bands of white and blue stripes rising diagonally from the lower corners to meet at the centre of the upper edge, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: inverted chevron of white and blue stripes rising from the lower corners to the middle of the upper edge
